description.en: Registers 13 native `codegraph_*` tools (status/init/index/sync/uninit/query/node/explore/files/callers/callees/impact/affected) wrapping the `codegraph` CLI, so the agent can bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph without grepping files.
description.zh: 注册 13 个原生 `codegraph_*` 工具（status/init/index/sync/uninit/query/node/explore/files/callers/callees/impact/affected），包装 `codegraph` CLI，让代理无需 grep 即可初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱。
